title: social cohesion: a new definition and a proposal for its measurement in africa
core_idea: Provides a narrow, operationalizable definition of social cohesion as three attributes—inclusive identity, trust, and cooperation for the common good—that operate along horizontal and vertical dimensions; and proposes a measurement strategy for Africa using household data (Afrobarometer) and expert data (V-Dem), with an indicator set intended as a first step toward global measurement.
tldr: Offers an operational definition of social cohesion (inclusive identity, trust, cooperation; horizontal/vertical) and proposes an Africa-focused measurement approach using Afrobarometer and V-Dem data as groundwork for broader measurement.
